source.name: Aptean Advanced Bundle for Beverage Manufacturing

mapping.summary: Beverage manufacturing and distribution bundle incl. excise and deposits
claims: Excise tax calculation and reporting on bonded location movements or invoices
Empties and deposit tracking for kegs, bottles, crates and pallets
Deposit balances for customers and vendors, split by type
Multi-level charges, promotional items and discounts with volume commitments
Fast sales order entry page with sorting, filtering and history
Order planning with own fleet or third-party shipper with weight and pallet constraints
Event management with loan material reservation and returns
Outlet and pub contracts with rent, loans and volume-based settlements
Advanced warehouse management extending standard BC
Alcohol balance reporting per warehouse for tax authorities
Beverage production enhancements such as active ingredient and principal component
